statement: The numbers of smooth plane cubics through 9−k general points and tangent to k general lines, in order k=0,…,9, are 1,4,16,64,256,976,3424,9766,21004,33616.

source.location: Corollary IV, §4, author preprint printed page 31; proof pages 31–33
source.version: Author-hosted 37-page preprint, Corollary IV; journal publication identity separately verified

notes:
Smooth genus-one cubics, not rational cubics. Ordinary tangencies and general conditions are essential. This supplies a modern proof of classical characteristic numbers.
